title: The Accidental Blogger: How I Ended Up on DEV
why_read: A personal, non-technical anniversary reflection post about the author's blogging journey, explicitly stated to not be technical content.
analysis: This is a personal essay by a Dev.to blogger reflecting on their first year of writing on the platform, including their motivations and some personal struggles. The author explicitly states upfront that readers looking for technical content should skip it. It offers no engineering substance and is only relevant to readers personally invested in the author's blogging journey.
